# CANDIDATE: VWAP Overnight Grinder

**Filed:** 2026-06-29
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture the edge in overnight price movements, specifically when the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) is broken. The hypothesis is that when the price breaks above or below the VWAP, it will continue in that direction, allowing us to ride the trend.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves using a VWAP calculation to determine the overnight trend. We will use a 30-minute VWAP calculation, starting from the previous day's close. If the price breaks above or below the VWAP, we will enter a trade in the direction of the break. The entry will be based on a limit order at the mid-point of the current bar.
